title: Real SPARC 175-galaxy fit (Lelli+ 2016 actual rotation curves)
data_source: SPARC database (Lelli, McGaugh, Schombert 2016 AJ 152 157), downloaded from astroweb.cwru.edu/SPARC, bundled in data/sparc/SPARC_Lelli2016c.mrt + data/sparc/Rotmod_LTG/
verdict: Real SPARC 175-galaxy fit (Lelli+ 2016): framework's parameter-free NFW with BTFR-derived M_200 and Bullock-Kolatt concentration achieves median chi^2/dof = 10.54 vs 2-parameter Burkert median 2.42. Framework wins AICc on 6/129 galaxies. chi^2/dof tier distribution (per-galaxy): EXACT (<1) = 5, PRECISE (<3) = 17, PRECISE_loose (<10) = 40, FACTOR2 = 39, ORDER = 28. This is the first head-to-head comparison of the framework's parameter-free halo prediction against the full SPARC sample with actual measured rotation-curve data points (no synthetic profiles).
